```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggbreak)
library(clinfun)
library(ggsignif)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(effsize)

source('~/CRISPR-KO-GuideRefine/GuideRefine_functions.R')
source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")
```

# Import alignment classification from each libraries

```{r}

pick_alignment_type <- function(classification_data, alignment_type, stratification_data) {
  data <- read_csv(classification_data) %>%
    filter(alignment %in% alignment_type)
  
  return(data)
}

avana_classification <- pick_alignment_type("../data/sgrna_lfc_data/avana_data/avana_sgrna_alignment_classification.csv", c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))
avana_classification <- count_alignment_bin(avana_classification, c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))

tkov3_classification <- pick_alignment_type("../data/sgrna_lfc_data/tkov3_data/tkov3_sgrna_alignment_classification.csv", c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))
tkov3_classification <- count_alignment_bin(tkov3_classification, c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))

yusa_classification <- pick_alignment_type("../data/sgrna_lfc_data/yusa_data/yusa_sgrna_alignment_classification.csv", c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))
yusa_classification <- count_alignment_bin(yusa_classification, c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))

brunello_classification <- pick_alignment_type("../data/sgrna_lfc_data/brunello_data/brunello_sgrna_alignment_classification.csv", c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))
brunello_classification <- count_alignment_bin(brunello_classification, c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))

jacquere_classification <- pick_alignment_type("../data/sgrna_lfc_data/jacquere_data/jacquere_sgrna_alignment_classification.csv", c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))
jacquere_classification <- count_alignment_bin(jacquere_classification, c("perfect", "multi-target guides", "non-targeting"))

```

# Bind every library into one single plot

```{r}

avana_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/avana_library.tsv",
                                                   "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/avana_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                   avana_classification[[1]])

tkov3_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/tkov3_guide_sequence.tsv", 
                                                   "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/tkov3_rpe1_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                   tkov3_classification[[1]])

yusa_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/yusa_hcrispr_ko_grnas.tsv", 
                                                 "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/yusa_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                 yusa_classification[[1]])

brunello_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/broadgpp-brunello-library-contents.tsv", 
                                                     "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/brunello_a375_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                     brunello_classification[[1]])

jacquere_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/Jacquere_PerGuideAnnotations_Quota4.tsv", 
                                                     "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/jacquere_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                     jacquere_classification[[1]])

avana_library_and_lfc_data <- avana_library_and_lfc_data %>% mutate(library = "avana") %>% drop_na()
tkov3_library_and_lfc_data <- tkov3_library_and_lfc_data %>% mutate(library = "toronto_v3") %>% drop_na()
yusa_library_and_lfc_data <- yusa_library_and_lfc_data %>% mutate(library = "yusa") %>% drop_na()
brunello_library_and_lfc_data <- brunello_library_and_lfc_data %>% mutate(library = "brunello") %>% drop_na()
jacquere_library_and_lfc_data <- jacquere_library_and_lfc_data %>% mutate(library = "jacquere") %>% drop_na()

```

# Calculate effect size of multi-target/single-mismatch sgRNA

```{r}

calculate_wilcoxon_cles(jacquere_library_and_lfc_data, "single mismatch", "perfect")

```

# Bind every library into one single plot of sgRNA Log2FC

```{r}
source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")

combined_data <- rbind(avana_library_and_lfc_data, 
                       tkov3_library_and_lfc_data, 
                       yusa_library_and_lfc_data, 
                       brunello_library_and_lfc_data, 
                       jacquere_library_and_lfc_data)

combined_data <- combined_data %>% mutate(library = factor(library, levels = c("brunello", "toronto_v3", "yusa", "avana", "jacquere")))


visualize_two_group(combined_data, 
                    "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/test.png")

```

# Generate plot of stratification multi-target sgRNAs

```{r}

source("./00_CRISPR-KO-library-survey-functions.R")

visualize_stratify_alignment(avana_library_and_lfc_data, "number of perfect on-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/avana_multi_target.png")
visualize_stratify_alignment(tkov3_library_and_lfc_data, "number of perfect on-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/tkov3_multi_target.png")
visualize_stratify_alignment(brunello_library_and_lfc_data, "number of perfect on-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/brunello_multi_target.png")
visualize_stratify_alignment(yusa_library_and_lfc_data, "number of perfect on-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/yusa_multi_target.png")
visualize_stratify_alignment(jacquere_library_and_lfc_data, "number of perfect on-target alignment", "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/jacquere_multi_target.png")
```
